parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: Configuration ID. It can be obtained by calling the [ListHttpResponseHeaderModificationRules](~~2867483~~) interface.

parameters.name: ResponseHeaderModification
parameters.description: Modify response headers, supporting three operation methods: add, delete, and modify.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Value range:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. Rules with smaller Numeric values are executed first.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) interface.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-http-response-header-modification-rule --site-id 123456000000 --config-id 352816096980000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --response-header-modification Type=static Value=headerValue Operation=add Name=headerName --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateHttpResponseHeaderModificationRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 123456000000 --RuleEnable on --ResponseHeaderModification '[{"Type":"static","Value":"headerValue","Operation":"add","Name":"headerName"}]' --ConfigId 352816096980000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --RuleName rule_example
